name: klais16-bauhaus
description: A dark techno x Bauhaus music video for openKolibri/klais-16. Music, picture and encode are all generated by code.

scripts.geometry: node tools/extract-geometry.mjs "$KLAIS16" > src/geometry/klais16.json && node tools/extract-font.mjs "$KLAIS16" > src/geometry/font16.json
scripts.audio: node src/audio/render-audio.mjs build && node tools/audio-qa.mjs build
scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run render
